_meta.description: EXPERIMENT — ROC-weighted momentum formula. Do NOT use for live trading. Must pass Scripts 16->17->18->19->20->21 gates before promotion to production. Production file: strategy_parameters.json (unchanged).

experiment.hypothesis: Research-aligned weighted ROC (Jegadeesh & Titman 1993) ranks stocks by recent trend acceleration rather than SMA-distance, potentially improving rank quality for steady compounders like BSP.XETRA.
experiment.promotion_gate: All gates in Scripts 19-21 must PASS before merging to production.

wfo_history.note: Fast grid trail=[3.0,3.5,4.0] — grid edge at 4.0 (5/11 windows). Mean=3.55 → 3.5 applied. Full-grid run may push trail higher. sma_slow mean=264 → 250 applied.

indicators._comment: Technical indicator periods. sma_fast/sma_slow drive compute_indicators() in Script 16/17. atr_period drives stop-loss sizing in Scripts 8/16. adx_period is fixed at 14 (Wilder standard).

trend_qualification._comment: Three-condition trend filter (Script 6). All three must be TRUE simultaneously. adx_threshold = entry gate. adx_weak = exit trigger (must be < adx_threshold). adx_weakness_days = consecutive days below adx_weak before exit.

momentum._comment: formula: 'roc_weight' uses weighted sum of ROC periods. Weights must sum to 1.0. roc_periods defines lookback windows (trading days). sma_period is used for trend filter context only, not for scoring.

stops._comment: ATR-based stop-loss system (Scripts 8/16). init_stop_mult: set once at entry, never lowered. trail_stop_mult: activates after trail_activation profit. Trailing updates Fridays only, ratchets up only.

position_sizing._comment: Inverse-ATR volatility-scaled sizing (Scripts 9/16). risk_per_trade = fraction of equity at risk per position. Floor/ceiling clip prevents outsized or negligible positions.

portfolio_constraints._comment: Hard and soft allocation limits (Scripts 9/11/14). max_crypto_pct is a hard cap. Sector and concentration limits are warnings that halt new entries. correlation_lookback_days is used for pairwise correlation check.

execution._comment: Transaction cost model (Script 16). cost_bps = round-trip basis points (10 bps = 0.10% per side). Slippage applied at fill simulation.

circuit_breakers._comment: Automated halt conditions (Scripts 11/14/16). cb_drawdown_halt triggers full entry suspension with cb_min_halt_days minimum pause. cb_drawdown_warn and cb_drawdown_watch are monitoring thresholds only. VIX resume requires cb_vix_resume_days consecutive days below cb_vix_resume.

backtesting._comment: Backtest engine defaults (Script 16). initial_equity is the default starting capital; always overridable via CLI. risk_free_rate used for Sharpe/Sortino. benchmark_symbol used for relative performance comparison.

walk_forward._comment: WFO window geometry (Script 17). is_months = in-sample optimization window. oos_months = out-of-sample validation window (12m prevents single-regime dominance). roll_months = step size between windows.

optimization_grid._comment: Full WFO parameter search space (Script 17). Only include parameters whose variation meaningfully changes strategy behaviour. Fixed params (sma_fast, adx_threshold, risk_per_trade) are in fixed_params below. Grid must never have all values at one edge — expand if optimizer converges to boundary. trail_stop_mult extended to 5.5 (Run 5: mean=4.82, recommended=5.5). max_positions mean=40 across runs — expand to 50 next iteration. | EXP-ROC adds roc_weights as a 3-value grid dimension covering short-biased (production-like), equal-weight, and long-biased (research-aligned).

optimization_grid_fast._comment: Reduced grid centred on full-grid WFO Run 1 results: sma_slow=250, trail_stop_mult=5.0, max_positions=40.

fixed_params._comment: Parameters excluded from WFO grid. sma_fast CV=0.374 (too unstable to optimize). adx_threshold=25 (raised from 15 — trade attribution 2022-2023 showed false entries below 25; FIX-6 ADX rising filter also applied in Script 16). init_stop_mult CV=0.000 across all 5 WFO runs — universally stable. trail_activation, risk_per_trade, cost_bps are strategy-design constants.

monte_carlo._comment: Simulation parameters (Script 18). All three methods must pass gates before live deployment.
